text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky is told to rest in the infirmary since she's not feeling well.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'll rest up and get back on the track—fatigue-free—in no time! Check you later! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh my, where am I? And where is everyone else?

text_block_list.name: New Human A
text_block_list.text: It is now 120 million years into your future. An ice age has destroyed the world of the past, including its products.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: How awful… My trainer and everyone else are—wait, even Italian food, Bavarian cream, and tiramisu are gone?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: How awful… My trainer and everyone else are—wait, even Italian food, Bavarian cream, and tiramisu are gone?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: There's still crop tops and orange smoothies, right? The cutting edge stuff is still around, right?!

text_block_list.name: New Human B
text_block_list.text: No. You are all that remains.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Bogus! What am I supposed to do in a place like this?
It's okay, Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Those screeching tires… Could it be… TATA?!

text_block_list.name: Tata
text_block_list.text: We may have lost the trendy fashions, but we still have you!

text_block_list.name: Tata
text_block_list.text: You have to tell them! It's what your trainer would've wanted!

text_block_list.name: Tata
text_block_list.text: You have to tell them! It's what your trainer would've wanted!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Tata… Trainer… You're right. This is no time to sit around moping!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Tata… Trainer… You're right. This is no time to sit around moping!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Listen, everyone! As the hippest person in this time, I must pass on knowledge of the bomb-diggitiest trends!

text_block_list.name: New Human C
text_block_list.text: Is this… the "disco" spoken of in legend? I can feel a "groove" building up inside of me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's the way! Come on, everyone! Shake your groove thangs and bring those fly moves back!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: …Huh? Was that all… a dream?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: What a strange dream… But I really feel like I accomplished something great! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to a good rest, Maruzensky seems to have gotten her groove back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky's efforts have made hip trends flourish on New Earth. But one day…

text_block_list.name: New Human C
text_block_list.text: The roof! The roof! The roof of the disco club is on fire! The probability it will burn down is too high—we do not need water!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: We do need water! Take a chill pill, and get some water!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Noooo! Totally boguuuus!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huh? I-it was a dream…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps because of some strange dreams, Maruzensky still feels tired even after resting.
